title: OHCHR documentation of Palestinian detainee treatment
summary: OHCHR documented consistent accounts of treatment of Palestinian detainees between 7 October 2023 and 30 June 2024.
claim: OHCHR documented accounts from released Palestinian detainees describing prolonged blindfolding and shackling, deprivation of food and sleep, beatings, stress positions and electric shocks while in Israeli custody.
legal_characterization: Documented accounts relevant to alleged torture or other ill-treatment; not an adjudication of any individual allegation.
source_organization: Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights
source_title: Detention in the context of the escalation of hostilities in Gaza (7 October 2023 - 30 June 2024)
verification_notes: Verified against the cited sections of the OHCHR thematic report, including its scope and methodology. OHCHR documents accounts and information; this record does not treat every reported incident as an adjudicated finding.
